_note: Five logo directions for MURBEREC, a people-first consulting firm that uses neuroscience to improve how people lead, learn and change (Diagnose, Design, Embed; no templates, no playbooks). Brand palette: near-black #09090B, off-white #FAF9F5, cyan #23D2E2. Every direction avoids a looping/infinity 'M', rainbow gradients and ribbon shapes, so nothing reads like the Meta logo. Rendered on a plain off-white background so the chosen mark is easy to vectorize and to invert for the dark site. The ® is added afterwards, not generated. Lesson from the first run: spelling the name out letter by letter made Qwen print the hyphens, so prompts now give the word once, in quotes.
negative: infinity symbol, looping ribbon, mobius strip, Meta logo, Facebook logo, rainbow gradient, multicolor gradient, 3D render, bevel, glossy, shadow, photo, mockup, business card, paper texture, watermark, signature, misspelled text, extra letters, duplicated letters, blurry, noisy, cluttered, busy background, clip art, cartoon, brain illustration with folds, lightbulb, puzzle piece, hyphens between letters, dashes in the word, spaced-out letters, vertical text, extra words, tagline, small text

concepts.name: Synapse monogram
concepts.idea: An angular M drawn as two neurons meeting at a synapse: the idea that change happens in the connection.
concepts.prompt: Professional minimalist vector logo for a neuroscience-based leadership consulting firm. A bold, angular geometric letter M monogram built from straight strokes of even weight, with sharp pointed peaks, never curved or looped. At the two top peaks and the centre valley sit three small solid circles like neural nodes, and the centre node glows cyan #23D2E2, suggesting a synapse firing between two neurons. The rest of the mark is solid near-black #09090B. To the right, the wordmark "MURBEREC" set in a heavy, wide, geometric uppercase sans-serif with tight letter-spacing, near-black. Flat vector, crisp clean edges, perfectly centered composition with generous empty space, plain solid off-white #FAF9F5 background. Swiss-style, timeless, premium corporate identity, logo design presentation.

concepts.name: Three steps (Diagnose, Design, Embed)
concepts.idea: Three rising vertical bars that together form an abstract M and stand for the firm's three-phase method.
concepts.prompt: Professional minimalist vector logo for a people-first consulting firm. The symbol is an abstract letter M formed by three solid vertical bars of increasing height with angled, sharply cut tops, like three rising steps: the first two bars near-black #09090B, the tallest third bar cyan #23D2E2, representing growth through three stages. Sharp geometric shapes only, no curves, no loops. Below the symbol, the wordmark "MURBEREC" in a bold, wide, geometric uppercase sans-serif with generous letter-spacing, near-black. Flat vector, crisp clean edges, centered stacked layout with lots of empty space, plain solid off-white #FAF9F5 background. Modern Swiss corporate identity, premium and confident, logo design presentation.

concepts.name: Human mind profile
concepts.idea: A simple human profile whose head holds a small constellation of connected points: people first, with the mind at the centre.
concepts.prompt: Professional minimalist vector logo for a people-first neuroscience consulting firm. The symbol is a clean, simple side profile silhouette of a human head facing right, drawn as a single solid near-black #09090B shape. Inside the head, in negative space, a small constellation of five connected dots linked by thin straight lines forms a subtle upward arrow, with one dot highlighted in cyan #23D2E2. Elegant, calm and intelligent, not a brain illustration. To the right, the wordmark "MURBEREC" in a heavy geometric uppercase sans-serif, near-black. Flat vector, crisp clean edges, balanced horizontal layout with generous empty space, plain solid off-white #FAF9F5 background. Premium corporate identity, logo design presentation.

concepts.name: Signal wordmark
concepts.idea: A confident wordmark with one small signal: a cyan node sitting on the letterforms like a thought lighting up.
concepts.prompt: Professional minimalist wordmark logo. The word "MURBEREC" set in a custom heavy, wide, geometric uppercase sans-serif with tight letter-spacing and perfectly even strokes, solid near-black #09090B. One distinctive detail: a small solid cyan #23D2E2 circle, like a neural node lighting up, sits just above the right shoulder of the final letter C, connected to it by a very short thin line. Nothing else, no symbol, no tagline. Flat vector, crisp clean edges, centered with generous empty space, plain solid off-white #FAF9F5 background. Editorial, Swiss, bold and premium, logo design presentation.

concepts.name: Constellation badge
concepts.idea: Connected points inside a precise circle that trace an M, like a network of people and ideas.
concepts.prompt: Professional minimalist vector emblem logo for a neuroscience-based leadership consulting firm. A precise thin circular outline in near-black #09090B contains a constellation of seven small solid dots connected by thin straight lines that trace a sharp, angular letter M, like a neural network or a network of people; the highest dot is cyan #23D2E2 and all others near-black. Strictly straight lines and dots, no curves inside, no loops. Below the emblem, the wordmark "MURBEREC" in a bold wide geometric uppercase sans-serif with generous letter-spacing, near-black. Flat vector, crisp clean edges, centered stacked layout with lots of empty space, plain solid off-white #FAF9F5 background. Modern premium corporate identity, logo design presentation.
